rows.user_input: What does RAG stand for in the context of AI?
retrieved_contexts: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is an AI framework that combines a retriever (which finds relevant documents) with a generator (typically a large language model) to produce answers grounded in the retrieved context.
RAG was introduced by Lewis et al. in 2020 to reduce hallucination in language models by giving them access to an external knowledge store at inference time.
rows.response: RAG stands for Retrieval-Augmented Generation, an AI framework combining a document retriever with a language model.

rows.response: Anthropic is an AI safety company founded in 2021 by Dario and Daniela Amodei. It produces the Claude family of large language models.
rows.reference: Anthropic is an AI safety company founded in 2021 that produces the Claude language models.

rows.user_input: What is the relationship between BlackRock and Bitcoin ETFs?
retrieved_contexts: In January 2024, BlackRock launched the iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT), one of the first spot Bitcoin ETFs approved in the United States.
BlackRock's IBIT became one of the fastest-growing ETFs in history, attracting billions in inflows within weeks of launch.
rows.response: BlackRock launched the iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT), one of the first U.S.-approved spot Bitcoin ETFs, in January 2024.
rows.reference: BlackRock issued one of the first approved U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs (IBIT) in January 2024.
